title: Final Frequency
description: Essential Criteria: The final peak frequency omega_f must be correctly expressed in terms of omega_i.

title: Temperature Relation
description: Important Criteria: The relationship between initial and final temperatures must be derived correctly using the adiabatic condition.

title: Volume Expansion
description: Important Criteria: The effect of volume expansion on the system must be correctly applied to derive the final state.

title: Density of States
description: Optional Criteria: The derivation of the density of states for the photon gas should be included to support the reasoning.

title: Adiabatic Process
description: Important Criteria: The understanding of the adiabatic process and its implications for energy density must be demonstrated.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect application of constants in the equations will result in a deduction.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Failure to maintain consistent units throughout the calculations will lead to errors in the final answer.
